scripted_policies.rubber_scripted_drag_v1: closed loop: a[0:2] = clip((goal - tip)[0:2] / max_translation_m_per_step, -1, 1), a[2:6] = 0 (tip = marker 8 of the observation)
scripted_policies.rubber_open_loop_v1: open loop, deterministic: a_k = (0.5, 0.3 (k even) / -0.3 (k odd), 0, 0, 0, 0.2) (rl.rubber_contract.contract_actions)
scripted_policies.rubber_scripted_pivot_v1: rubber_scripted_pivot_v1 (rl.rubber_scripted.scripted_pivot_v1, code commit 45ce7be): deployable policy observation only. psi_g = grip yaw from the observed grip quaternion; bearing b = goal_xy - grip_xy, rho = |b|; l = |marker 8 - marker 0| (xy); tip error e = goal_xy - tip_xy, dist = |e|. If dist <= eps (4 mm): a = 0. Elif dist <= r_fine (15 mm): a[0:2] = k_fine e / 0.005, yaw 0. Else: a[0:2] = k_radial (rho - l) (cos psi_g, sin psi_g) / 0.005, a[5] = k_yaw wrap(atan2(b) - psi_g) / 0.05. a[2:5] = 0; clipped to [-1, 1]; float32. No workspace clipping (the env holds out-of-box steps)
scripted_policies.rubber_scripted_pivot_hold_v1: rl.rubber_scripted.ScriptedPivotHoldV1 (code e0e6968), deployable policy observation only (grip pose, markers, marker velocities, goal, preload flag), state per env: a latched hold flag (cleared on reset and during preload). Approach (not holding): grip yaw toward the goal bearing at k_yaw x the heading error (psi_g from the observed grip quaternion), grip translation along its own axis by k_radial (rho - l) (rho = |goal - grip|, l = |marker 8 - marker 0|). Latch: hold = True when the tip distance <= r_in, False when > r_out. Hold: yaw 0; translation k_hold (e - k_v v_tip control_dt) (e = goal - tip, v_tip = observed tip-marker velocity), 0 while |e - k_v v_tip control_dt| <= deadband. Actions / 0.005 m and / 0.05 rad, clipped to [-1, 1], float32

RL-02.b_gpu_L2: N 8 (slot_seed 0), rubber_scripted_drag_v1, 60 control steps: after every step every observation and reward finite, particle mass constant between resets, BatchedRubberMaterial.audits() and the contact ownership audit 0, invalid bits 0

RL-03.name: randomisation
RL-03.procedure: (i) CPU: two cpu_parity_v1 envs with identical seeds: byte-identical material parameters (params, mass, params64, traction, goal, preload) and states after the reset and after 2 control steps; (ii) every sampled value inside its declared range, mu0 / rho inside the batch step rule (CFL <= 0.5 at the batch dt) and friction inside the envelope; (iii) a partial reset of env 1 with a new seed changes only env 1's rows; (iv) 2,000 host samples per parameter (family.sample, seeds 0 ... 1999, the declared task) vs the declared uniform distributions: scipy.stats.kstest p >= 0.001 for each of the 11 non-degenerate draws; friction_table (degenerate range [0.3, 0.3]) equals 0.3 in every sample; (v) seeded slot selection reproducible and covering the 9 slots for N 64 / slot_seed 0; (vi) a slot change on reset refused (UNSUPPORTED_GEOMETRY_CHANGE_ON_PARTIAL_RESET), friction above the envelope refused (UNSUPPORTED_FRICTION_OUT_OF_ENVELOPE); GPU: (vii) the declared task N 8: two resets with the same seeds give identical device parameter rows (params, mass, params64, traction, goal) and every value in range

RL-04.name: isolation
RL-04.a_cpu_L1: cpu_parity_v1 N 3, two envs A and B with the same seeds except env 1 (B: seed 64 -> different material, friction, traction, preload, goal) and env 1's actions (B: -a); envs 0 / 2 byte-identical between A and B after every control step (every state array, detector, outputs); a masked reset of env 1 after step 4 (seed 65) equals env 1 of a fresh env reset with seeds 61, 65, 63 (every array incl. visco, contact, S1 and preload / goal / traction state) and evolves like it for 2 more steps
RL-04.b_gpu_09: N 4 on the GPU (slots L100_t4, L100_t5, L125_t4, L100_t6), episodes of 15 control steps from a full reset, k 5 A / 5 B interleaved A, B, A, B, ... in one env / process; B changes env 1's seed (1300) and actions (-a of rubber_open_loop_v1); for every control step, every env e in {0, 2, 3}, every observable (9 markers, 9 marker velocities, grip wrench, plane wrench, the diagnostics summary) and component: d = max_{i,j} |A_i - B_j|, s = max(range A, range B); PASS iff d <= lam s + eps_rel max_i |A_i| (eps_rel times the largest |component| of the observable vector) with lam 4, eps_rel 1e-6 (the rubber_contact_tests_v2 -09 rule, unchanged)
RL-04.pass: a byte-wise; b the rule holds for every scalar

RL-05.name: episode semantics
RL-05.procedure: CPU (cpu_parity_v1): every rubber invalid bit (1, 2, 4, 8) written into the batch's sticky invalid table maps to TERM_MATERIAL_INVALID with info invalid_reason carrying the bit, terminated True, the invalid penalty applied; a physical NONFINITE_STATE (a NaN particle velocity in one env) gives bit 1 for that env only, finite observations (nan_to_num) and a finite reward; truncation exactly at max_episode_steps; the reward equals a host float64 recomputation from host copies (tip, goal, L, clipped action, preload flag, invalid bits) every step (|diff| <= 1e-12 relative, float32 cast identical); evaluator unit tests (window, tolerance, terminal bits, preload exclusion); the S1 tests (a)-(f) of tests/test_rubber_self_penetration.py pass in the same suites. GPU sanity: N 8 (slot_seed 0, seeds 8000 + e), 80-step episodes (10 preload), one episode with rubber_scripted_pivot_hold_v1 (parameters in tests.RL-05.controller_v4; class rl.rubber_scripted.ScriptedPivotHoldV1) and one with the zero action from the same seeds
RL-05.pass: every CPU clause holds; GPU: scripted mean return > zero-action mean return in >= 7 of 8 envs and >= 1 evaluator success (rubber_tracking_eval_v1) in the scripted episode
RL-05.pass_unchanged: the v2 pass criterion verbatim: scripted mean return > zero-action mean return in >= 7 of 8 envs and >= 1 evaluator success (rubber_tracking_eval_v1: 10 mm for the last 25 steps, unchanged)

RL-08.name: dt / spacing on the RL scene
RL-08.procedure: single env GPU (LiveRubberMaterial via family.build_life), slot L125_t4, nominal recipe material with friction_table at the range midpoint, no traction; declared scripted grip path: steps 1-10 lift 10 mm (smootherstep), 11-30 hold, 31-60 drag +x 30 mm (smootherstep); O1 = tip marker position after step 30, O2 = peak |grip force| over the run, O3 = tip x displacement over steps 31-60 (slip on the table); dt: CFL 0.5 vs 0.25 at n_t 4; spacing: t 4 mm at n_t 4 / 6 / 8 (dx t / n_t, CFL 0.5)
RL-08.pass: dt scored: |dO1| / L <= 1e-3 and |dO3| / O3 <= 1 %; spacing reported with the RUBBER-PHYS-11 rule block (rubber_gci: observed order, GCI with its declared Fs rule, the Phase 1 comparison text) unchanged; the material's scored spacing test remains RUBBER-PHYS-11; b: the bias and the trigger outcome reported (the trigger is a decision, not a PASS / FAIL)
RL-08.b_q1w_bias_on_the_rl_geometry: K2 Q1w condition 3: the RUBBER-PHYS-11 Q1 static sag (rubber_refinement.case_q1: clamped strip, gravity from alpha 0.05, mu0 0.4 MPa, beta 20, CFL 0.5, static_stop_v3, profile options of the task) on the P2-6 geometry L/t 37.5, W/t 4, t 4 mm (the L150_t4 slot, the largest L/t of the slot set), single env on the GPU at n_t 4 / 6 / 8; bias(n_t 4) = phi(4) / phi_ext - 1 with phi_ext the extrapolation of n_t 6 / 8 at p_eff = clip(p_obs(4, 6, 8), 1, 2) (the -11 rule block, rubber_gci.study); GCI reported
